title: Bake-off (validators): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

conflicts: Other kinds of power in NEAR: governance voting power (House of Stake veNEAR) and token ownership. This flower draws staking/delegation power only.
inferred: The tail segment pools every pool not drawn individually (311 pools) and no individual claim attaches to them.

mappings.why: the validator's share of stake this epoch, compressed into a band
square root of the validator's share of stake this epoch
kind of account: staking pool, liquid-staking contract, or unknown
each pool's delegation is split by backer class: lockups, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, other delegators
largest stake first, clockwise from the top

power_means.claim: Power in this flower is stake this epoch: each validator's share of 593,372,642 NEAR of delegated stake, which drives block production weight.

interpretation.summary: This flower draws the 60 largest NEAR validators by stake this epoch (371 total, as of 2026-11-03). Each side's backing is split by backer class — lockups, liquid-staking contracts, 1M+ NEAR accounts, and other delegators — so you can see who actually stands behind each pool. Concentration is moderate: the top 5 pools hold 21.1% and 9 pools could reach a one-third threshold (Nakamoto coefficient 9); HHI 0.0215, Gini 0.836. Addresses are not people: pools and delegator accounts may represent many humans.
unknowns: Pool identities are self-declared (pool-details.near); owners behind lockups were not resolved.
Liquid-staking contract token holders (e.g. STNEAR/LiNEAR holders) are not listed, so ultimate ownership behind those delegations is unknown.
424 idle pools were not crawled, so some small delegators are missing.
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded per pool and class.
On-chain delegation does not prove ultimate beneficial ownership.
